summary: Morpheus comes flying down the stairs but halts when he hears POLICE swarming below, discovering the way down is occupied.

what_changes.after: Stopped by the sound of POLICE swarming below, blocking his path.
what_changes.evidence: Flying downstairs, Morpheus stops, hearing POLICE SWARMING below.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus fleeing down the stairwell runs into police swarming the lower levels.

uncertain: Whether Morpheus retreats, finds another route, or is trapped, since the scene ends at the moment he stops.
